title.hi: Aapki awaaz maayne rakhne lagti hai

body.en: Hearing begins around now. Your voice is lower than hers and carries further into the womb. This is the first thing that is yours to give and nobody else's.
body.hi: Sunna ab shuru hota hai. Aapki awaaz uski awaaz se gehri hai aur womb ke andar door tak jaati hai. Yeh pehli cheez hai jo sirf aap de sakte hain, koi aur nahi.
